1: prakṛitiṁ puruṣhaṁ chaiva kṣhetraṁ kṣhetra-jñam eva cha |
etad veditum ichchhāmi jñānaṁ jñeyaṁ cha keśhava ||
2: idaṁ śharīraṁ kaunteya kṣhetram ity abhidhīyate |
etad yo vetti taṁ prāhuḥ kṣhetra-jña iti tad-vidaḥ ||
3: kṣhetra-jñaṁ chāpi māṁ viddhi sarva-kṣhetreṣhu bhārata |
kṣhetra-kṣhetrajñayor jñānaṁ yat taj jñānaṁ mataṁ mama ||
4: tat kṣhetraṁ yach cha yādṛik cha yad-vikāri yataśh cha yat |
sa cha yo yat-prabhāvaśh cha tat samāsena me śhṛiṇu ||
5: ṛiṣhibhir bahudhā gītaṁ chhandobhir vividhaiḥ pṛithak |
6: mahā-bhūtāny ahankāro buddhir avyaktam eva cha |
7: ichchhā dveṣhaḥ sukhaṁ duḥkhaṁ saṅghātaśh chetanā dhṛitiḥ |
12: etaj jñānam iti proktam ajñānaṁ yad ato ’nyathā ||
13: jñeyaṁ yat tat pravakṣhyāmi yaj jñātvāmṛitam aśhnute |
anādi mat-paraṁ brahma na sat tan nāsad uchyate ||
14: sarvataḥ śhrutimal loke sarvam āvṛitya tiṣhṭhati ||
15: asaktaṁ sarva-bhṛich chaiva nirguṇaṁ guṇa-bhoktṛi cha ||
16: bahir antaśh cha bhūtānām acharaṁ charam eva cha |
sūkṣhmatvāt tad avijñeyaṁ dūra-sthaṁ chāntike cha tat ||
17: avibhaktaṁ cha bhūteṣhu vibhaktam iva cha sthitam |
bhūta-bhartṛi cha taj jñeyaṁ grasiṣhṇu prabhaviṣhṇu cha ||
18: jyotiṣhām api taj jyotis tamasaḥ param uchyate |
jñānaṁ jñeyaṁ jñāna-gamyaṁ hṛidi sarvasya viṣhṭhitam ||
19: iti kṣhetraṁ tathā jñānaṁ jñeyaṁ choktaṁ samāsataḥ |
20: prakṛitiṁ puruṣhaṁ chaiva viddhy anādī ubhāv api |
vikārānśh cha guṇānśh chaiva viddhi prakṛiti-sambhavān ||
22: puruṣhaḥ prakṛiti-stho hi bhuṅkte prakṛiti-jān guṇān |
23: paramātmeti chāpy ukto dehe ’smin puruṣhaḥ paraḥ ||
24: ya evaṁ vetti puruṣhaṁ prakṛitiṁ cha guṇaiḥ saha |
26: anye tv evam ajānantaḥ śhrutvānyebhya upāsate |
28: vinaśhyatsv avinaśhyantaṁ yaḥ paśhyati sa paśhyati ||
29: samaṁ paśhyan hi sarvatra samavasthitam īśhvaram |
na hinasty ātmanātmānaṁ tato yāti parāṁ gatim ||
30: yaḥ paśhyati tathātmānam akartāraṁ sa paśhyati ||
31: tata eva cha vistāraṁ brahma sampadyate tadā ||
32: śharīra-stho ’pi kaunteya na karoti na lipyate ||
34: yathā prakāśhayaty ekaḥ kṛitsnaṁ lokam imaṁ raviḥ |
kṣhetraṁ kṣhetrī tathā kṛitsnaṁ prakāśhayati bhārata ||
35: bhūta-prakṛiti-mokṣhaṁ cha ye vidur yānti te param ||
